name: AI Video Agent - Daily YouTube Upload

metadata.notes: Runs once daily at 9:00 AM. Adjust the 'time' field to your preferred upload time.

messages.content: You are an expert YouTube content strategist and scriptwriter. Always respond with valid JSON only.

Generate a complete YouTube video concept for today ({{formatDate(now; 'YYYY-MM-DD')}}). Return a JSON object with these exact keys:
- title: engaging YouTube title (max 70 chars)
- description: full YouTube description (250-350 words) with relevant hashtags at the end
- tags: array of 10-15 SEO keyword tags (strings)
- script: full video narration script (500-700 words), divided into intro, main_points (array of 3 sections), and outro
- thumbnail_text: short punchy text for the thumbnail overlay (max 6 words)
- category: YouTube category name (e.g. Education, HowTo, Entertainment)
Pick a trending, high-interest topic suitable for a short-form informational video.

metadata.notes: Generates title, description, tags, script, and thumbnail text via ChatGPT. Requires an OpenAI connection in make.com.
Parses the JSON string returned by OpenAI into individual fields usable by later modules.

mapper.body: {"videoName": "{{3.title}}", "videoDescription": "{{3.description}}", "language": "en", "webhook": "", "scenes": [{"text": "{{3.script.intro}}", "voiceOver": true, "splitTextOnNewLine": true, "splitTextOnPeriod": true}, {{#each 3.script.main_points}}{"text": "{{this}}", "voiceOver": true, "splitTextOnNewLine": true, "splitTextOnPeriod": true}{{/each}}, {"text": "{{3.script.outro}}", "voiceOver": true, "splitTextOnNewLine": true, "splitTextOnPeriod": true}], "brandLogo": {"url": "", "verticalAlignment": "bottom", "horizontalAlignment": "right"}}

metadata.notes: Submits the AI-generated script to Pictory to create the video. Replace API key and User ID with your Pictory credentials. Swap this module's URL/headers to use D-ID, Synthesia, or any other video API.
Waits 3 minutes for the video generation job to complete. Increase if your videos take longer (e.g., 300 for 5 minutes).
Polls Pictory for the completed video URL using the job ID returned in step 4. Adjust the endpoint path for other video APIs.
Downloads the rendered video file from Pictory's CDN as a binary file for upload to YouTube.
Uploads the video to YouTube with AI-generated title, description, and tags. categoryId 27 = Education. Change to: 24=Entertainment, 26=HowTo, 28=Science&Tech, 22=People&Blogs.
Optional: posts a Slack notification when the upload succeeds. Remove this module if you don't use Slack, or swap for Gmail, Telegram, Discord, etc.
